name: Privy Agent Wallets
description: Wallets for agents: policy-bounded server wallets an agent controls, funded by card, bank or stablecoin, paying via transfers, x402 and MPP. Includes an agent wallet CLI. Owned by Stripe.

skills.name: Hold Funds in Agent Wallet
skills.description: Creates wallets that an agent controls through authorization keys, or user-owned wallets with the agent added as a scoped signer.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Attaches policies with transfer limits, contract and recipient allowlists and time windows that bound what an agent can sign.

skills.name: Pay with x402
skills.description: Pays x402 and Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) endpoints from a Privy wallet so agents can buy API calls autonomously.

skills.name: Run Agent Wallet CLI
skills.description: Lets agents like Claude Code create, fund and spend from sandbox wallets via a CLI, after one browser approval by the user.
